messages:
lee: FYI NovaEdge POC hitting bad TTFT tail. Median ~300ms but when they hit ~120 concurrent connections we see 1.5s-4s spikes. They also reported intermittent 429s and a lot of TLS "client hello" timeouts in their gateway logs. Demo on Friday, want this stable.

lee: pasted log snippet from their gateway:
```
2026-03-19T09:14:02Z TLS: client hello timeout from 10.8.2.45
2026-03-19T09:14:03Z 502 upstream reset for /v1/generate id=nx-998
2026-03-19T09:14:03Z request_id=nx-998 latency=3214ms status=502
```

anika: thanks. can you confirm whether their SDK is using connection pooling/keepalive vs frequently opening new connections? also need the api_key for route metrics.

lee: they say "we use an internal managed gateway so connections look short-lived by default". sent api_key: nova-poc-777.

tom: quick read: two choke points often cause this pattern: (1) TLS/connection churn -> retries and TCP queueing; (2) batching window + many short requests causing large batch_wait_ms leading to TTFT spikes. Also KV prefix cache misses can make model side slower on first tokens.

tom: triage plan:
- get runtime route metrics for nova-poc-777 (batch_window_ms, avg batch_size, batch_wait_ms distribution)
- check runtime traces for kv_cache_hit flags and model queue times
- search deploy history for recent batching heuristic changes

infra-bot: deploy 2026-03-19T01:52:13 updated batching.short_seq_heuristic in cluster-west-2 by ci-bot. No rollback on record.

zara: for a fast mitigation we can push a route override for the POC: lower batch_window_ms to 2ms, cap max_batch_size to 16, enable prefix_kv_cache with small TTL (5m) and bump edge keepalive to 120s for that api key. That should reduce queueing and suppress TLS churn by keeping connections open longer.

anika: client asks for the exact command we will run so they can audit.

tom: command I'll execute once you approve:
```
redwood routes update --api-key=nova-poc-777 \
  --set batch_window_ms=2 \
  --set max_batch_size=16 \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true \
  --set prefix_kv_cache.ttl=300 \
  --set edge.keepalive=120s
```
I'll monitor metrics for 20m and share a before/after snapshot.

lee: customer cannot change their managed gateway quickly. asked if Redwood can also increase idle timeout on our edge as a bandaid.

zara: yes we can. infra-bot will apply edge idle bump for that api key.

infra-bot: config-change 2026-03-19T09:40:05 applied: route_override(nova-poc-777) batch_window_ms=2, max_batch_size=16, prefix_kv_cache.enabled=true ttl=300, edge.keepalive=120s, edge.idle_timeout=110s.

lee: after 12m of testing: median TTFT improved from 310ms -> 360ms (slightly higher median due to smaller batches) but 95p dropped from ~3.4s -> 780ms. Still seeing a few ~1.2s outliers. sample trace:
```
req=nx-1054 stage=queue wait_ms=420 batch_wait_ms=760 model=redwood-xsmall seq_len=18 batch_size=12 kv_cache_hit=true latency_total=1240ms
```

anika: that trace shows we still have some queue wait + model time but the big tail removed. kv_cache_hit=true indicates cache warm for that request, so earlier cold misses were likely exacerbating earlier spikes.

tom: recommend two follow-ups:
1) Supply a 8-10 prompt prefill pack for their most common paths to ensure warm KV for demo. Solutions can send them.
2) If they want zero-risk for the demo window, offer a short dedicated burst pool. I computed rough costs: 6 hours of a small dedicated burst to hit 250 qps peak ~ $450. One full week with same sizing ~ $1.6k. We can offer a 6-hour demo credit waiver for first-time POCs.

lee: they asked about security (KMS, rotation, SOC2) while we do this. forwarding to security separately.

zara: action items:
- tom/anika: monitor batch_size distribution and batch_wait_ms for 24h, roll back heuristic if it regresses
- solutions (zara): create 8-prompt prefill + customer instructions to hit KV warm quickly
- sales (lee): confirm demo credit acceptance with finance and customer

anika: I'll also flag the recent batching.short_seq_heuristic deploy to infra team to do an A/B rollback if we see more regressions across POCs.

lee: customer reports: after changes they see stable demo load with occasional 900ms outliers but no 3s spikes. demo on Fri confirmed. thanks all :party_parrot:
